text: Chapter 9: Recapturing Eldenbaum@The Man Who Seeks Death
■Next Mission\nMove from Gravel Terrace to Inanis Wilderness to start.
Look for Balft and the troops from El Scaro who are\nbattling to stop the powerful Coenubia's attack!
Go to back up Balft and the garrison commander\nwho went first to find the Coenubia boss!
Balft and the garrison commander are being surrounded\nby monsters. Kill all the monsters to save them!
Go after Balft who went ahead by himself and\ndon't let him do anything stupid!
Go after Balft who has become desperate and\nintends to fight the enemy alone!
Help Balft who keeps on battling Vulture although\nhe is tuckered out and defeat the monster!
Return to Dikkit Sector from El Scaro with the teleporter!
